references.text: Parallel birth narrative: Zilpah's firstborn son (Gad) and Bilhah's firstborn son (Dan mark the beginning of the tribes from the slave women.
Birth narrative (chapter 30) and tribal summary (chapter 46): Zilpah's role as mother to two tribes is fully established here.
Connects the single birth in Paddan-Aram with the final list of Jacob's sons as patriarchs.
Cause (the giving of the slave woman) and effect (the birth): Zilpah's role in the family is established here.
Detailed birth narrative (Zilpah's son) is included in the total summary of Leah's household.
